typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @MARKET VARCHAR(100) DECLARE @MARKET1 VARCHAR(100) DECLARE @MARKET2 VARCHAR(100)  SET @MARKET = SUBSTRING( CAST(? AS VARCHAR) ,1, CHARINDEX(\'|\',CAST(? AS VARCHAR))-1)  IF(CHARINDEX(\',\',@MARKET)!=0) 	BEGIN 		SET @MARKET1 = SUBSTRING( @MARKET ,1, CHARINDEX(\',\',@MARKET)-1)  		SET @MARKET2 = SUBSTRING( @MARKET ,CHARINDEX(\',\',REVERSE(@MARKET))+1, CHARINDEX(\',\',REVERSE(@MARKET))-1)  	END ELSE 	BEGIN 		SET @MARKET1 = @MARKET 		SET @MARKET2 = \'\'     END   SELECT [Market]       ,[ProviderName]       ,[ProviderEin]       ,[ProviderNPI]       ,[RecipientFirstName]       ,[RecipientLastName]       ,[RecipientMedicaidId]       ,[PayerRecipientMemberId]       ,[Setting_cd]       ,[ServiceCode]       ,[ServiceCodeMod1]       ,[ServiceCodeMod2]       ,[DiagnosisCode]       ,[PayerAuthId]       ,[PayerSecondaryAuthId]       ,[AuthEffDate]       ,[AuthExpDate]       ,[AuthAmount]       ,[AuthNote]    FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[POMELO_AUTHS_EXTRACT]     WHERE Market = @MARKET1    UNION    SELECT [Market]       ,[ProviderName]       ,[ProviderEin]       ,[ProviderNPI]       ,[RecipientFirstName]       ,[RecipientLastName]       ,[RecipientMedicaidId]       ,[PayerRecipientMemberId]       ,[Setting_cd]       ,[ServiceCode]       ,[ServiceCodeMod1]       ,[ServiceCodeMod2]       ,[DiagnosisCode]       ,[PayerAuthId]       ,[PayerSecondaryAuthId]       ,[AuthEffDate]       ,[AuthExpDate]       ,[AuthAmount]       ,[AuthNote]    FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[POMELO_AUTHS_EXTRACT]     WHERE Market = @MARKET2      ORDER BY [PayerRecipientMemberId], [PayerSecondaryAuthId]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTablePOMELOAUTHSEXTRACT
SourceTablePOMELOAUTHSEXTRACT sink(input(
		ProviderEin as string,
		RecipientLastName as string,
		Setting as string,
		RecipientFirstName as string,
		DiagnosisCode as string,
		PayerAuthId as string,
		ProviderNPI as string,
		AuthNote as string,
		Market as string,
		PayerRecipientMemberId as string,
		PayerSecondaryAuthId as string,
		ProviderName as string,
		ServiceCode as string,
		AuthEffDate as string,
		RecipientMedicaidId as string,
		ServiceCodeMod1 as string,
		AuthAmount as string,
		ServiceCodeMod2 as string,
		AuthExpDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ProviderEin,
		RecipientLastName,
		Setting = Setting_cd,
		RecipientFirstName,
		DiagnosisCode,
		PayerAuthId,
		ProviderNPI,
		AuthNote,
		Market,
		PayerRecipientMemberId,
		PayerSecondaryAuthId,
		ProviderName,
		ServiceCode,
		AuthEffDate,
		RecipientMedicaidId,
		ServiceCodeMod1,
		AuthAmount,
		ServiceCodeMod2,
		AuthExpDate)) ~> FlatFileAuthsKY
